t: This is Borough High Street, a road in Southwark that runs south-west from London Bridge. It forms part of the A3, the route that leads all the way to Portsmouth on the south coast. The architect Edmund Blacket was born here in 1817. He later made his career in Australia, where he's best known for designing the University of Sydney, St Andrew's Cathedral in Sydney, and St Saviour's Cathedral in Goulburn.
